definition: Developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 119 (DEE119; OMIM #621304) is a genetic neurodevelopmental disorder caused by pathogenic variants in the small nuclear RNA (snRNA) gene RNU2-2, characterized clinically by neurodevelopmental delay, severe intellectual disability, and frequent epilepsy.

source.title: Systematic analysis of snRNA genes reveals frequent RNU2-2 variants in dominant and recessive developmental and epileptic encephalopathies
source.quote: phenotype associated with dominant or biallelic RNU2-2 variants is characterized by neurodevelopmental delay, severe ID and epilepsy
